about: In 2017, I embarked on my journey into coding and web development by creating a standalone project for an academy. This marked the beginning of my passion for technology. Since then, I’ve had the opportunity to build web applications for a small business and a start-up as a freelancer.
Fast-forward to today, I’m working as a Software Developer at Antino Labs, where I focus on developing products and leading projects for our clients.
In my spare time, I enjoy exploring new technologies through certified courses. I also dedicate time to building projects to apply and enhance the skills gained during my learning journey.
When I’m away from my desk, you’ll often find me reading literature, traveling to explore nature, or spending quality time with friends.
